jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A project manager (PM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiating through Closing phases. However, the PM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project manager’s role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders.
  
The PM is responsible for overseeing, and performing project management functions on all AVE projects, budgets and scopes. The PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for technicians, managing deliverables from engineering, CAD and Programming and overseeing the completion of projects. The PM is responsible for completing systems integration projects on time, on budget and achieving high customer satisfaction from our customers.
  
The majority of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes.
  
As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship.
  
They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.
  
* Coordinates and communicates.
* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget
* completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities
* clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be
* successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to AVE installation projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, installation technicians, subcontractors, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor, equipment and materials budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members.
* Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Performs field verification of prospective work site. Documents all issues with site and keeps everyone informed of potential issues and solutions.
* Coordinates all drawings and documentation between all internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitates and directs design reviews to assure proper documentation in the field.
* Coordinates all system programming and final checkout of systems. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors and other trades when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates training \& turnover of projects to client, service department, \& sales.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different and every set of project stakeholders is different. The PM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between system design, site conditions and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence and people management skills. The PM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality and client satisfaction are a very complex
  
set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

1\. Takes full ownership of project
  
a. Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
  
b. Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client
  
satisfaction.
  
c. Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget
  
performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
  
d. Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
  
2\. Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
  
3\. Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole
  
decision maker.
  
  

**Physical Working Environment:****Physical Demands:**  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an
  
employee. The employee may be exposed to construction site conditions on a regular
  
basis. Employee will be responsible for their safety while on job sites and to comply with all safety
  
regulations in place by the GC. Use of PPE is usually required on job sites. The employee can typically
  
spend at least 40% of their time

**About Foodsmart:**  

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition\-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.



Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer\-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.



Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost\-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. Customer First \- You start with the member and work backwards.  

Make It Happen \- You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.

**About the Role:**  

Foodsmart seeks a service\-oriented Food Operations Analyst to join our dynamic, fast\-growing team on a full\-time basis. This role will serve as the primary coordinator of food delivery for members enrolled in our meal\-delivery and support programs. Through this role, your expertise in customer support and service excellence will ensure our members experience the highest level of compassion and care.

* Provide high\-quality customer support to our many existing and future members, from initial inquiry to ongoing program questions
* Utilize existing resources, tools, and team members to quickly address any member order fulfillment issues
* Ensure member orders are fulfilled accurately and to the highest quality standard
* Contribute suggestions to continue optimize the member ordering and fulfillment process
* Ability to support other key needs as defined

### **You are:**

* Compassionate about our members, many of whom rely on the food delivered to support them or their loved ones during difficult times
* Detail oriented, ensuring the food orders placed are accurate and timely
* Driven to support our members through quick yet thorough issue resolution
* Adaptable and ready to try new approaches as we onboard new clients and new processes \- a willingness to offer and implement even better solutions is always encouraged

* High school diploma or GED required
* Minimum of 2 years work experience in customer support roles
* Self\-motivated and driven
* Strong computer proficiency including good knowledge of Microsoft/GSuite applications
* Preferred:
	+ Ability to troubleshoot and resolve client issues in real time
	+ Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and problem\-solving skills to resolve member issues efficiently

**About the role**


In the Project Manager, Carbon Operations role, you will sit at the intersection of science, protocol enablement, and water sector and carbon market engagement. You will ensure that our wastewater alkalinity enhancement projects are rigorously validated, transparently credited, and effectively sold while supporting our wastewater sector initiatives.


You will play a key role driving excellence in measurement, reporting and verification (MRV) strategy and application. You will be responsible for driving the MRV program within CREW, quarterbacking new buyer application processes, and forging partnerships with external verifiers, protocol developers, registries, and carbon credit buyers. You will also help shape CREW’s broader market strategy through engagement with registries, buyers, policymakers, industry coalitions, and grant funding opportunities.


This is an ideal opportunity for a detail\-oriented, mission\-driven operator who can seamlessly transition from deep technical protocols to external stakeholder engagement across both the climate tech and utility sectors.


This position is a full\-time role onsite at our office in Brooklyn, NY.

**Responsibilities**

* MRV \& Protocol:


	+ Drive the development and refinement of CDR protocols, managing relationships with key registries, credit buyers, governments, and standards bodies.
	+ Lead end\-to\-end project validation and verification processes with independent third parties, including data delivery, coordination, and attendance at onsite visits.
	+ Collaborate with our R\&D and Lab Ops \& Operations teams to ensure MRV methodologies are technically rigorous and aligned with industry requirements, while working with R\&D and Lab Ops, Operations and Finance teams to optimize credit delivery.
* Water Sector Implementation


	+ Collaborate with internal engineering teams to align carbon removal operations with the day\-to\-day priorities, constraints, and process optimization goals of municipal wastewater treatment facilities.
	+ Monitor and engage with evolving state, federal, and international policy frameworks relevant to wastewater treatment, greenhouse gas removal, and environmental impact.
	+ Build trusted relationships across the broader water utility ecosystem, registries, standards bodies, and industry coalitions to position CREW’s technology as a win\-win for climate and clean water.
* Offtake:


	+ Opportunistically support the end\-to\-end process of applying to CDR buyer programs and carbon marketplaces, managing initial RFI through successful onboarding.
	+ Track offtake pipeline and coordinate reporting and delivery of credits with buyers.

**Experience Requirements**

* 5–8\+ years of experience in carbon markets, climate tech, environmental engineering, project development, consulting, or related fields.
* Experience working with carbon registries, carbon credit buyers, and/or policy stakeholders is strongly preferred.
* Strong background in climate science, geochemistry, oceanography, or related fields.

* You love being in the trenches with your team and working with high empathy.
* You have a growth mindset.

CREW’s technology and services make wastewater treatment cheaper and more efficient, while permanently sequestering CO₂.


Leveraging advanced chemistry, natural minerals, and AI, we’ve developed and are deploying a category\-defining process intensification technology, with decarbonization at its core. We are currently deploying this technology across the US and Europe. In addition, we’ve signed $40M\+ in carbon removal offtake agreements with leading corporations looking to meet their climate goals, supercharging geographical CREW’s expansion.


CREW has offices and labs in New Haven, CT and offices in Brooklyn, NY.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


The Senior Epic BI Developer is a highly skilled technical expert responsible for building, optimizing, and supporting Epic and non‑Epic analytics solutions and downstream data workflows in collaboration with the BI team. This role centers on hands‑on development, troubleshooting complex reporting issues, improving data pipelines, and ensuring high‑quality, reliable analytics products across the East Hawaii Region. The Senior Developer mentors’ BI staff, performs advanced SQL and Epic reporting development, and serves as the technical lead for BI operations, system enhancements, and analytics integrations. In addition, the Senior Developer acts as the primary escalation point for complex issues and supports the organization in shaping long‑term data governance and technical standards.


Location: This position allows for a hybrid (remote/in office) work environment, with a requirement for an incumbent living outside of Hilo to work on\-site at HBMC at regular intervals throughout the year (approximately four times per year for visits of approximately one week each). Travel expenses will be paid for by the organization, in accordance with our policies.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Technical Leadership \& BI Support**
--------------------------------------

* Serve as the top technical escalation point for Epic reporting issues, data integrity concerns, and analytics platform performance challenges.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, optimization, and issue resolution across Epic and non\-Epic BI tools.
* Ensure analytic environments remain stable, performant, and technically sound.

**Downstream Workflow Development**
-----------------------------------

* Build, validate, and optimize downstream workflows including extracts, cubes, semantic layers, and automated data pipelines.
* Improve pipeline reliability, data refresh performance, and workflow accuracy through hands\-on engineering.
* Verify correct movement of data across source systems, staging layers, and BI platforms.

**Epic Reporting \& BI Development**
------------------------------------

* Develop complex SQL queries, metrics, dashboards, and analytic models using Epic and enterprise BI tools.
* Own the technical development lifecycle including requirements translation, build, testing, and deployment.
* Maintain reporting definitions, metadata, and Analytics Catalog content.

**System Build \& Epic Maintenance**
------------------------------------

* Configure, test, and maintain Epic Foundation System components supporting analytics.
* Lead technical execution for upgrades, releases, and changes impacting BI workflows.
* Conduct environment testing, performance tuning, and validation of analytics components.

**Technical Mentorship \& Documentation**
-----------------------------------------

A project manager (PM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiating through Closing phases. However, the PM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project manager’s role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders.
  
The PM is responsible for overseeing, and performing project management functions on all AVE projects, budgets and scopes. The PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities.

The PM is responsible for completing systems integration projects on time, on budget and achieving high customer satisfaction from our customers.
  
The majority of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes.
  
As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship.
  
They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.
  
* Coordinates and communicates.
* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.

* completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities
* clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be
* successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to AVE installation projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, installation technicians, subcontractors, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor, equipment and materials budgets.

* Develops and maintains all related project schedules.

* Facilitates and directs design reviews to assure proper documentation in the field.
* Coordinates all system programming and final checkout of systems. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors and other trades when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates training \& turnover of projects to client, service department, \& sales.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different and every set of project stakeholders is different. The PM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between system design, site conditions and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. set of variables.

1\. Takes full ownership of project
  
a. Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
  
b. Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client
  
satisfaction.
  
c. Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget
  
performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
  
d. Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
  
2\. Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
  
3\. Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole
  
decision maker.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an
  
employee. The employee may be exposed to construction site conditions on a regular
  
basis. Employee will be responsible for their safety while on job sites and to comply with all safety
  
regulations in place by the GC. Use of PPE is usually required on job sites. The employee can typically
  
spend at least 40% of their time

**About the role and team**
---------------------------


The Audit Technology Support \& Implementation Manager is responsible for leading the day\-to\-day operation of the ATT Support function, ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery of support across Audit Tools and Techniques (ATTs). The role will act as the primary escalation and coordination point between the support function and the Director of Audit Technology Support and Implementation.


The role focuses on coordinating support activity across onshore and offshore teams, managing demand from audit teams, and ensuring issues are resolved effectively and efficiently. The role plays a central position within the ATT support model, acting as the primary escalation point and ensuring alignment between service delivery, audit team needs, and the broader Transformation and ATT landscape. In doing so, the role enables audit teams to confidently adopt and use technology in practice, while ensuring the support model remains scalable, controlled, and continuously improving.

* Oversee the day\-to\-day delivery of support across all ATTs, ensuring tickets are managed effectively and resolved within agreed service levels.
* Monitor incoming support demand and ensure appropriate triage, prioritisation and allocation of work across the support team.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex issues, service risks and operational challenges, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
* Coordinate workload across onshore and offshore teams, ensuring effective utilisation of resources and alignment to demand.
* Work closely with Assistant Managers to oversee offshore delivery, ensuring quality, consistency and accuracy of responses provided to audit teams.
* Track and monitor support performance metrics, including ticket volumes, response times, resolution times and recurring issues.
* Provide structured, timely communication and regular reporting to Director of Audit Technology Support and Implementation on service performance, emerging risks, and key trends impacting ATT usage and adoption.
* Liaise with internal teams including Transformation, Data Analytics, IT and Methodology to coordinate issue resolution and support requirements.
* Manage relationships with third\-party vendors and support providers, ensuring effective escalation and resolution of external issues.
* Ensure consistent and practical communication with audit teams, providing updates on issue status, timelines and resolutions where required.
* Identify recurring issues and root causes, driving actions to reduce repeat queries and improve overall service efficiency.
* Support the development and maintenance of knowledge bases, FAQs and standard guidance to improve user self\-service capability.
* Drive continuous improvement in support processes, workflows and operating model, ensuring scalability as ATT adoption grows.
* Support onboarding of new ATTs into the support model, ensuring readiness, documentation and clear processes are in place.
* Support ATT implementation and rollout activity, ensuring alignment between deployment and ongoing support requirements.
* Contribute feedback into product and tool development based on user issues and support trends.
* Support delivery of training, drop\-in sessions and guidance to improve user adoption and confidence.
* Assist in defining and refining service levels, support processes and operating frameworks for new tools.
* Contribute to broader Transformation initiatives where support insights can enhance delivery or outcomes.
